definitions.gloss: original text; original wording; the original
definitions.explanation: The text in its original form before translation, editing, or adaptation.

examples.japanese: {原文|げんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{原文|げんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}みたい→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I want to read this novel in the original.

examples.japanese: ⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{原文|げんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュアンス→ニュアンス：11138_nyuansu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The translation is well done, but it differs slightly from the nuance of the original text.

notes:
Composed of {原|げん} (original/source) and ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (text/writing). Most commonly used when discussing translations, quotations, or edited works where comparison to the original is relevant.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原文|げんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read in the original language
- {原文|げんぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: as it is in the original
- {原文|げんぶん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忠実|ちゅうじつ}→忠実：12570_chuujitsu⟧: faithful to the original text
- {原文|げんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引用|いんよう}する→引用する：26928_inyousuru⟧: to quote the original text

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原作|げんさく}→原作：11827_gensaku⟧: original work — refers to the original creative work (novel, manga, etc.) that an adaptation is based on
- ⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧: manuscript, draft — a written document before publication
- ⟦{原典|げんてん}→原典：29714_genten⟧: original source — the primary source document, often academic
